english: Just look at this place, Abu. We’re standing in a mountain of gold.
spanish_translation: Solo mira este lugar, Abu. Estamos parados en una montaña de oro.
chinese_translation: 阿布，看看这个地方。我们正站在一座金山上。

english: Remember what that giant sand head said—touch nothing except the lamp.
spanish_translation: Recuerda lo que dijo esa cabeza gigante de arena: no toques nada excepto la lámpara.
chinese_translation: 还记得那个巨大的沙头说了什么吗——除了神灯，什么都不要碰。

english: There it is, right on that pedestal.
spanish_translation: Ahí está, justo en ese pedestal.
chinese_translation: 就在那里，就在那个底座上。

english: All this treasure, and that strange old man just wants an ancient piece of junk?
spanish_translation: ¿Tomo este tesoro, y ese viejo extraño solo quiere una pieza de chatarra antigua?
chinese_translation: 这么多宝藏，那个怪老头居然只要一件破旧的古董？

english: Abu, keep your hands in your pockets. I mean it.
spanish_translation: Abu, mantén las manos en tus bolsillos. Hablo en serio.
chinese_translation: 阿布，把手放在口袋里。我是认真的。

english: Almost got it... got it! See? Easy as stealing a loaf of bread.
spanish_translation: Casi lo tengo... ¡lo tengo! ¿Ves? Tan fácil como robar un trozo de pan.
chinese_translation: 快拿到了……拿到了！看到了吧？就像偷一块面包一样简单。

english: Abu? What are you looking at?
chinese_translation: 阿布？你在看什么？

english: Abu, drop that ruby! Put it back right now!
spanish_translation: ¡Abu, suelta ese rubí! ¡Ponlo de vuelta ahora mismo!
chinese_translation: 阿布，放下那个红宝石！立刻把它放回去！

english: No, don't touch!
chinese_translation: 不，别碰——！

english: INFIDELS!
chinese_translation: 无徒们！

english: You have touched the forbidden treasure!
chinese_translation: 你们触碰了被禁止的宝藏！

english: Now you shall never see the light of day again!
spanish_translation: ¡Ahora nunca más verán la luz del día!
chinese_translation: 现在你们将永远再也看不到天日！

english: The whole ground is collapsing!
chinese_translation: 整个地面都在塌陷！

english: Jump, Abu! Grab my shoulder!
chinese_translation: 跳过来，阿布！抓住我的肩膀！

english: Aladdin! Help!
chinese_translation: 阿拉丁！救命！

english: I’ve got you! Don't let go of my neck!
spanish_translation: ¡Te tengo! ¡No te sueltes de mi cuello!
chinese_translation: 我抓住你了！别松开我的脖子！

english: The entrance is sealing up—run!
chinese_translation: 入口正在封闭——快跑！

english: We’re not going to make it!
chinese_translation: 我们要赶不上了！

english: Uh oh
chinese_translation: 噢-噢……

english: Hang on!
chinese_translation: 抓紧了！
